why: पवमानेन is the regular instrumental of पवमान, fits त्वया ... सोम.
पवमानँ is the accusative with the edition's chandrabindu for anusvara.
पवमानाः is the nominative plural agreeing with अपघ्नन्तः स्वर्दृशः.
पवमानं is the accusative agreeing with मधुश्चुतम्.
A halanta न् before a space is not a Sanskrit form; the vocative पवमान is needed and restores the 8-syllable pada.
धारयापो is the sandhi of धारया + अपो; अपो वसानः makes sense.
हवामह इन्द्रं is correct sandhi of हवामहे before a vowel.
Letters, sandhi and sense are regular; nothing wrong in the line.
